articles.summary: A newly published exploit for the 'Copy Fail' vulnerability allows unprivileged local attackers to gain root permissions on Linux systems. This local privilege escalation flaw affects kernels released since 2017, posing a significant risk to a wide range of Linux distributions and their users.

articles.summary: North Korean threat actors are responsible for a staggering 76% of all cryptocurrency stolen in 2026, engaging in frequent and large-scale heists. The report suggests that AI may be playing a role in enhancing their capabilities, highlighting a major geopolitical and financial security concern.

articles.summary: Researchers have discovered a critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-3854) in GitHub.com and GitHub Enterprise Server that allows authenticated users to achieve remote code execution with a single 'git push' command. This command injection flaw poses a significant risk to repositories with push access.

articles.summary: A critical vulnerability (CVE-2026-25874) has been disclosed in Hugging Face's popular open-source robotics platform, LeRobot, potentially allowing unauthenticated remote code execution. The flaw stems from untrusted data deserialization and carries a CVSS score of 9.3.

articles.summary: Researchers have uncovered 'Fast16,' a Lua-based malware dating back to 2005, predating the infamous Stuxnet worm. This cyber sabotage framework was designed to tamper with high-precision calculation software, indicating early sophisticated threats targeting industrial and engineering systems.

articles.title: VECT 2.0 Ransomware Irreversibly Destroys Files
articles.summary: The VECT 2.0 ransomware operation is acting more like a wiper, irreversibly destroying files larger than 131KB across Windows, Linux, and ESXi systems. This critical flaw in its encryption implementation means recovery is impossible, even for the threat actors.

articles.summary: Microsoft has patched a critical flaw in Microsoft Entra ID where the 'Agent ID Administrator' role could be exploited for privilege escalation and identity takeover attacks. This role, intended for AI agents, inadvertently provided excessive permissions.

articles.summary: CISA and US government partners have released a guide to accelerate the adoption of Zero Trust principles within Operational Technology (OT) environments. This guidance is crucial for enhancing the security of critical infrastructure.

articles.title: Unpatched Windows 'PhantomRPC' Flaw Allows Privilege Escalation
articles.summary: A critical vulnerability named 'PhantomRPC' has been discovered in Windows, allowing for privilege escalation. The flaw stems from an architectural weakness in how the Remote Procedure Call (RPC) mechanism handles connections to unavailable services, and remains unpatched.

articles.summary: The Lazarus Group, a North Korean state-sponsored actor, is reportedly targeting macOS users, particularly high-value leaders and organizations. They are utilizing the ClickFix tool for initial access and data theft, indicating a continued focus on Apple's ecosystem.
